headline: US 30-Year Mortgage Rate Dips to 7.32%, Pushing Home Prices Lower
summary: The 30-year fixed-rate mortgage dropped slightly to 7.32% as prospective home buyers continue to struggle with affordability. Home prices are starting to drop in some areas as a result.
why: Mortgage rates dictate housing market affordability and consumer borrowing costs across the United States economy.

impacts.name: Real Estate
impacts.why: Elevated borrowing costs constrain buyer purchasing power, forcing downward adjustments on property prices.
